Report.description: Told how far along the job is.

Cancel.description: Asks the job to stop. Releasing a reference to it is not this, and cancelling the call that returned it is neither.

Rename.description: Renames the job and answers what it is now called.

ProgressSink.description: An interface, which is a record of callable members; each member is its own binding.

Job.description: What start answers: a record whose members are separately released.

Watchers.description: Callables in a list, each of which may be null.

Outcome.description: Callables in a sum: one arm carries them and one carries nothing.

Start.description: A callable supplied as an argument, beside data.

start.description: Takes a callback and answers a record of callables.

settled.description: A sum carrying callables, emitted by the server.

supervise.description: The reverse direction: the server hands the client callables to call.
